name: Minesweeper
summary: Clear a nine-by-nine board without hitting a mine.
description: Launch Minesweeper from the apps menu (or type /minesweeper) and clear the board together - tap to reveal, or switch to flagging to mark a mine. The first tap is always safe. Ten mines in eighty-one cells, and the field is rebuilt from a seed each frame rather than carried in the shared state, so nobody can read the answer off the board. Press 'new game' for a fresh field.
author: slim-m

permissions.name: Play Minesweeper
permissions.description: Launch and play a Minesweeper board in this space.

extension_points.name: play
extension_points.description: Play a move, or start a board.
